cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Efficiency Win
cards.instruction: Celebrate each inconvenience as proof that a faster, cheaper, or smarter routine can now be invented.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lift's broken. Excellent: cancel the gym and take the stairs. Use a steady pace, please; this is conditioning, not a sprint.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A complete session built into the journey home. Recover on each landing, not halfway across a step.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the shopping? I'm carrying six bags.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect, resistance work included. Balance three on each side and swap hands at the landings. We'll finish the errands and the workout on the same staircase.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 pacing, A3 landing recovery and A5 load balancing make A trainer expertise convert inconvenience into combined routines.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 eight floors produces A3 full session; B4 six bags produces A5 resistance loading, but swapping balanced hands adds no clear benefit.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 state actual travel and shopping burdens while A celebrates each as savings.

heightening.evidence: A5 combines B4 errands with exercise but explains the achieved efficiency after the routine is apparent.

specificity.evidence: A1 broken lift and B4 six bags establish the practical task; a hand swap of three per side is not clearly useful.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final same-staircase explanation can be a direct pace or rest instruction.
